correctness.rationale: The exact autocorrelation equations force coincident endpoints signs; cross-sign lag singleton exclusion resolves supports with <=4 points. The only multi-cancellation four-point pattern forces equal outer gaps and signed reflection via two bilinear equations. A reciprocal quadratic factor gives a two-parameter five-point family with identical coordinate moduli and Fourier intensity; unequal endpoint moduli prevent reflection. Exact finite consistency tests are supplemental, not an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Comparison against Shkarin’s exact four-consecutive-step complex classification, Novikov–Xu’s general discrete Pauli constructions, two sampled-Pauli source manuscripts, and indexed scientific claims did not find arbitrary-spacing real four-site rigidity plus a sharp five-site counterexample. residual_risks: A pre-2026 classification of sign ambiguity in real finite impulse response polynomials under equal coordinate magnitudes may already contain this five-support threshold but not be indexed with Pauli terminology.
